ValidationRule.description: Certan scenarios for chargebacks to enforce ARD before putting on hold
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.SC_BypassValidationRules) && RecordType.DeveloperName = "Chargebacks" && (ISPICKVAL (SC_ChargebacksScenario__c, "Fraud SG") || ISPICKVAL (SC_ChargebacksScenario__c, "Pre Compliance")) && ISBLANK( SC_ActionRequiredDateTime__c ) && ISCHANGED(Status) && CONTAINS(TEXT(Status), "On Hold")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please set an Action Required Date before putting the case on hold.
